title: Integrity
description: snapshot/integrity.json and assessments/<id>/integrity.json -- engineering plan section 8.4. Per-file SHA-256 plus the aggregate hash exactly as computed by Get-EntraPostureAggregateHash (src/Integrity/AggregateHash.ps1): sorted by normalized relative path, ordinal comparison, 'path\0size\0hash' records joined by LF.

relativePath.description: Forward-slash only -- a literal backslash in a stored relativePath means normalization was skipped somewhere and this record cannot be trusted.

fileHash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256, matching Get-EntraPostureFileHash's normalized output.

recordCount.description: Must equal files array length -- checked by the Contract test suite, not expressible as a schema-only constraint against another array's length.

signatureStatus.description: Section 8.4's four bundle states. 'Unsigned' is a valid, visible state -- never silently omitted or defaulted to look like 'Signed'.

signature.description: Detached signature reference, present only when signatureStatus is 'Signed' or 'InvalidSignature' (there is something to point at); explicit null for 'Unsigned' and 'HashMismatch'.
